candidates.title: US 10-year Treasury yield moves above 5% as oil and inflation fears hit bonds
candidates.whyItMayWork: A 5% Treasury yield is an unusually clear numerical hook for US-stock audiences and links rates, oil, inflation and growth-stock valuation in one explainer.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: Market levels move quickly; every quoted yield/oil value must retain an observation timestamp and be refreshed before production.
candidates.followUpOrComments: Follow with Fed decision and current Treasury/oil levels; no canonical social engagement was visible in this run.
candidates.images: No Reuters photography or charts copied; media reuse rights unresolved.
